tips.t: Picture and video generation runs best on NVIDIA; AMD cards work for chat but are slower for images and video.
A slower card with 16 GB is usually a better AI buy than a faster one with 12 GB, because bigger, smarter models fit entirely on it.

tips.b: Check the graphics card's memory on the listing.
tips.t: Some cards come in two versions (the RTX 5060 Ti has 8 GB and 16 GB); for tier 3 you want the 16 GB one.

Roughly: tier 1 is any current PC, tier 2 a mid-range gaming PC, tier 3 upper mid-range, tier 4 high-end (mostly because of the graphics card). Models, parts and prices change often — compare the specs above.
